definitions.ask: Should ⌃↵ put the caret on the reading-task line, not just open the file at the top?
definitions.why: reading tasks live in long area notes, so landing on the line saves a search every time

choices.label: Lands the caret on the task's ^block line via bob-goto-task (bob-navigation-hotkeys ≥ 2.32.0)
Opens the file via obsidian://open like ⌘↵ does; you find the task in the note yourself

definitions.ask: Should the Bob Refs footer advertise `⌃↵ Task` in its widest hint variants?
definitions.why: the footer is width-tuned to 760 pt and the ⌘K menu already shows the shortcut

choices.label: The footer stays as it is; ⌃↵ appears in the ⌘K menu and the docs only
Adds `⌃↵ Task` to the widest footer variants only; mid-width panels drop ⌘1–5 Scope sooner
